module: Computation of the vehicle thumbnail output paths for the thumbnail composer. All files go in vehicles/<modelKey>/ in .jpg format; a config's thumbnail is named <config>.jpg, and default.jpg for the default config in "defaults" mode. Names are sanitized (characters other than letters, digits, _, . and - replaced by _).
notes: captureMode is "defaults" (only the default config is written, under the name default.jpg) or "all" (one thumbnail per config; the default config is also copied to default.jpg via paths.defaultFinal).
makeOutputPaths creates the output folder (FS:directoryCreate): it has a side effect on the disk.
hasThumbnail tests <config>.jpg then <config>.png in vehicles/<modelKey>/ (relative path, i.e. user folder and game folder via the virtual file system).

safePathPart.desc: Sanitizes a piece of file name: replaces any character outside [A-Za-z0-9_.-] with _; returns "unknown" if the result is empty.

getFinalOutputPath.desc: Computes the final path of a thumbnail and its folder.

hasThumbnail.desc: Indicates whether a thumbnail (.jpg or .png) already exists for the item.

makeOutputPaths.desc: Creates the output folder and returns the paths to use for the capture.

returns.desc: {outputFolder, final, defaultFinal = default.jpg path to copy ("all" mode, default config)}.
